mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate drops below 0.10%, it indicates an aggressive monetary easing response to economic weakness, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.10%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as corporate earnings face pressure from weak consumer spending, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits are expected to fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) drop below 470.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 470.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 225.0 and a decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.15% indicates a policy response to inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates a soft landing.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 225.0 and FEDFUNDS falls below 0.15%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.15%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where industrial production (INDPRO) has declined by more than 2.0% over the past three months, the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to expectations of reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO has declined by more than 2.0% in the past three months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
